# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# The 909 cymbals as IMA ADPCM: tests/host/drum909_adpcm_test.c against tests/host/cymbal_ref.py's
# references (the approved A/B study in ../adpcm_ab when it is there; set CYM_AB to another folder).
#   tests/host/run_drum909_adpcm.sh
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
CC="${CC:-cc}"
OUT=build/host
mkdir -p "$OUT"
python3 tools/gen_drum_samples.py build/gen/x0x_drum_samples.h >/dev/null
python3 tests/host/cymbal_ref.py "$OUT/cym_ref" ${CYM_AB:+"$CYM_AB"}
"$CC" -std=c99 -O2 -ffp-contract=off -Wall -Wextra -Wdouble-promotion -Wno-unused-function -Werror \
    -Ifirmware/src -Ifirmware/src/dsp -Ibuild/gen -o "$OUT/drum909_adpcm_test" tests/host/drum909_adpcm_test.c -lm
"$OUT/drum909_adpcm_test" "$OUT/cym_ref"

/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
 * Copyright (C) 2026 Leo Kuroshita (@kurogedelic), Hügelton Instruments
 * SMK-37 Pro port: Copyright (C) 2026 M. Geisler (genkigenki/makkuro) */
/* The flash map: which ranges the RAM flash driver (fm1_flash.h) may erase / program, per board
 * (BOARD_SMK37, fm1_cc.h). Macros and compile-time checks only, so host tests can include it. */
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include "fm1_cc.h"

/* [off, off + n) inside [lo, hi), without wrapping: off + n can overflow, and
 * the 1 MiB part ignores the high address bits, so a wrapped range lands low. */
#define FL_IN(off, n, lo, hi) ((uint32_t)(off) >= (lo) && (uint32_t)(off) <= (hi) && \
                               (uint32_t)(n) <= (hi) - (uint32_t)(off))
/* The flash chip the app's storage accepts (JEDEC id from 0x9F; app/main_fm1.c). One place; extend it
 * here for another part. */
#if BOARD_SMK37
/* SMK-37 Pro: 0xEB6014, 1 MiB, read from a unit over mask-ROM UBOOT (2026-10-09; jl-uboot-tool "Online device:
 * ID: 0xeb6014"). The driver uses only generic SPI NOR commands (9F, 05/35, 06, 20, 02, 0B). */
#define FL_JEDEC_OK(id) ((id) == 0xEB6014u || (id) == 0x856014u)
#else
#define FL_JEDEC_OK(id) ((id) == 0x856014u)
#endif

#if BOARD_SMK37
/* ---- SMK-37 Pro flash map (hardware notes: https://github.com/genkigenki/fm1-to-smk37) ----
 *   0x00000-0x03FFF  head (SPL, isd_config)         NEVER
 *   0x04000-0x9CFFF  app area (stock PRCT end), SFC-encrypted   update loader only (FL_APP)
 *     0x04120-0x8AFFF  app code (app.bin offset 0 .. FL_APP_CODE_MAX; build.py links to it)
 *     0x8B000-0x9AFFF  Bluetooth controller block, 64 KiB, one piece (FL_BLE; XIP 0x02087000), in app.bin
 *     0x9B000-0x9CFFF  app slot end (0x9B520, APP_SLOT 0x97400 as stock), cfg_tool, region table, cfg
 *   0x9D000-0xAFFFF  VM: X0X store (storage.c: 7 objects, A/B, 0x9D000-0xAAFFF; boot screen
 *                    copies 0xAB000 and 0xAC000; spare 0xAD000-0xAEFFF; owner tag 0xAF000)  FL_DATA
 *   0xB0000-0xBAFFF  VM spare, 44 KiB, not a sample slot and not linker code. The app
 *                    code region ends at the Bluetooth block (0x8B000). The settings store,
 *                    this spare, the update area and calibration sit after that. Moving
 *                    calibration would not join this spare to the code the linker can use. FL_SMPV
 *   0xBB000-0xBFFFF  VM: M-UPGRADE loader staging + update record (ota.c)          FL_OTA
 *   0xC0000-0xC0FFF  BTIF (BT pairing)              NEVER
 *   0xC1000-0xC1FFF  USRTRIM (key/pad/wheel calibration, "trimdat")   NEVER
 *   0xC2000-0xF3FFF  user sample slots 1 (80 KiB) and 2 (120 KiB; app/slots.c): stock USRFLASH
 *                    0xC2000-0xEAFFF and the unlisted 0xEB000-0xF3FFF                FL_SMP
 *   0xF4000-0xFDFFF  USR (stock resources; kept for a rollback)   NEVER
 *   0xFE000-0xFEFFF  free, unused (4 KiB: too small for a slot)
 *   0xFF000-0xFFFFF  key_mac                        NEVER
 * Everything below is an explicit allow-list; the asserts keep each allowed window out of the
 * protected ranges at compile time. */
#define FL_HEAD_HI      0x00004000u                /* protected: [0, FL_HEAD_HI) */
#define FL_CAL_LO       0x000C0000u                /* protected: BTIF + USRTRIM */
#define FL_CAL_HI       0x000C2000u
#define FL_USRRES_LO    0x000F4000u                /* protected: stock USR resources */
#define FL_USRRES_HI    0x000FE000u
#define FL_KEYMAC_LO    0x000FF000u                /* protected: key_mac and above */
#define FL_APP_LO       0x00004000u                /* the update loader: app area */
#define FL_APP_HI       0x0009D000u
#define FL_REC_LO       0x0009D000u                /* the update loader: where it may drop records (VM only) */
#define FL_REC_HI       0x000C0000u
#define FL_PLAIN_LO     0x0009D000u                /* plain XIP window from the VM start */
#define FL_DATA_LO      0x0009D000u                /* X0X store */
#define FL_DATA_HI      0x000B0000u
#define FL_SMPV_LO      0x000B0000u                /* VM spare, not a sample slot (app/slots.c) */
#define FL_SMPV_HI      0x000BB000u
#define FL_OTA_LO       0x000BB000u                /* M-UPGRADE loader staging, ota.c */
#define FL_OTA_HI       0x000C0000u
#define FL_SMP_LO       0x000C2000u                /* user sample slots (app/slots.c) */
#define FL_SMP_HI       0x000F4000u
/* the Bluetooth controller block (step 5): one 64 KiB piece of the encrypted app area, at the top of the
 * stock app slot (0x4120 + APP_SLOT 0x97400 = 0x9B520), sector aligned. The app code ends below it. */
#define FL_APP_SLOT_END 0x0009B520u
#define FL_BLE_LO       0x0008B000u
#define FL_BLE_HI       0x0009B000u
#define FL_APP_CODE_MAX (FL_BLE_LO - 0x4120u)      /* 0x86EE0 = 552,672 B (tools/fm1pkg_make.py APP_CODE_MAX) */
/* a window [lo, hi) is allowed: sector aligned, non-empty, and clear of every protected range */
#define FL_WIN_SAFE(lo, hi) ((lo) % 0x1000u == 0u && (hi) % 0x1000u == 0u && (lo) < (hi) && \
                             (lo) >= FL_HEAD_HI && (hi) <= FL_KEYMAC_LO && \
                             ((hi) <= FL_CAL_LO || (lo) >= FL_CAL_HI) && \
                             ((hi) <= FL_USRRES_LO || (lo) >= FL_USRRES_HI))
_Static_assert(FL_WIN_SAFE(FL_DATA_LO, FL_DATA_HI), "SMK: FL_DATA overlaps a protected range");
_Static_assert(FL_WIN_SAFE(FL_OTA_LO, FL_OTA_HI), "SMK: FL_OTA overlaps a protected range");
_Static_assert(FL_WIN_SAFE(FL_SMP_LO, FL_SMP_HI), "SMK: FL_SMP overlaps a protected range");
_Static_assert(FL_WIN_SAFE(FL_SMPV_LO, FL_SMPV_HI), "SMK: FL_SMPV overlaps a protected range");
_Static_assert(FL_DATA_HI <= FL_SMPV_LO && FL_SMPV_HI <= FL_OTA_LO, "SMK: FL_SMPV overlaps the store or the OTA area");
_Static_assert(FL_BLE_LO % 0x1000u == 0u && FL_BLE_HI - FL_BLE_LO >= 0x10000u && FL_BLE_LO >= FL_APP_LO + 0x120u &&
               FL_BLE_HI <= FL_APP_SLOT_END && FL_APP_SLOT_END <= FL_APP_HI,
               "SMK: the Bluetooth block must be one 64 KiB piece inside the app slot");
_Static_assert(FL_WIN_SAFE(FL_APP_LO, FL_APP_HI), "SMK: FL_APP overlaps a protected range");
_Static_assert(FL_WIN_SAFE(FL_REC_LO, FL_REC_HI), "SMK: FL_REC overlaps a protected range");
_Static_assert(FL_REC_HI == FL_CAL_LO && FL_OTA_HI <= FL_REC_HI && FL_OTA_LO >= FL_REC_LO,
               "SMK: the update record (OTA area) must lie in the loader's record window, below BTIF");
_Static_assert(FL_DATA_HI <= FL_OTA_LO && FL_APP_HI <= FL_DATA_LO, "SMK: windows overlap");
/* the update loader (loader.c): the app area, and records only in the VM below BTIF */
#define FL_LDR_RANGE_OK(off, n) (FL_IN(off, n, FL_APP_LO, FL_APP_HI) || FL_IN(off, n, FL_REC_LO, FL_REC_HI))
/* X0X's own store: FL_DATA and the sample slots */
#define FL_STORE_OK(off, n) (FL_IN(off, n, FL_DATA_LO, FL_DATA_HI) || FL_IN(off, n, FL_SMP_LO, FL_SMP_HI) || \
                             FL_IN(off, n, FL_SMPV_LO, FL_SMPV_HI))
#ifndef FL_RANGE_OK
#define FL_RANGE_OK(off, n) (FL_STORE_OK(off, n) || FL_IN(off, n, FL_OTA_LO, FL_OTA_HI))
#endif
/* second, independent net in the RAM driver: [off, off + n) touches a protected range (also when a
 * caller supplies its own FL_RANGE_OK, as the update loader does) */
#define FL_HITS(off, n, lo, hi) ((uint32_t)(off) < (hi) && \
                                 ((uint32_t)(off) >= (lo) || (uint32_t)(n) > (lo) - (uint32_t)(off)))
#define FL_PROTECTED(off, n) (FL_HITS(off, n, 0u, FL_HEAD_HI) || FL_HITS(off, n, FL_CAL_LO, FL_CAL_HI) || \
                              FL_HITS(off, n, FL_USRRES_LO, FL_USRRES_HI) || (uint32_t)(off) >= FL_KEYMAC_LO || \
                              (uint32_t)(n) > FL_KEYMAC_LO - (uint32_t)(off))
#define FL_GUARD(off, n) (FL_RANGE_OK(off, n) && !FL_PROTECTED(off, n))
#else /* FM-1 */
/* FM-1 boot screen copies: the 4 KiB gap after the song object (0x9E000 ends at
 * 0x9F000, samples start at 0xA0000) and the unused third globals sector
 * (settings use 0xFC000 and 0xFD000). app/boot_screen.h. Not sample slots. */
#define FL_PLAIN_LO     0x00093000u                /* plain XIP window from the FM-1 VM start */
#define FL_DATA_LO      0x00097000u                /* Felucca main store */
#define FL_DATA_HI      0x000E0000u
#define FL_GLOB_LO      0x000FC000u                /* Felucca superblock / globals */
#define FL_GLOB_HI      0x000FF000u
#define FL_OTA_LO       0x000E0000u                /* M-UPGRADE loader staging, ota.c */
#define FL_OTA_HI       0x000E5000u
/* Felucca's own store (projects, user samples; settings) */
#define FL_STORE_OK(off, n) (FL_IN(off, n, FL_DATA_LO, FL_DATA_HI) || FL_IN(off, n, FL_GLOB_LO, FL_GLOB_HI))
/* Where the RAM driver may erase / program. The app build allows only its own
 * data regions; the update loader (firmware/loader) defines its own window. */
#ifndef FL_RANGE_OK
#define FL_RANGE_OK(off, n) (FL_STORE_OK(off, n) || FL_IN(off, n, FL_OTA_LO, FL_OTA_HI))
#endif
#define FL_GUARD(off, n) FL_RANGE_OK(off, n)
#endif /* BOARD_SMK37 */

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""SMK-only update runner regression with generated scratch inputs, no SDK or target build.

Run python3 tests/host/test_smk_update_contract.py. Exercises the real package maker,
OTA and loader host tests, installer parity, and gate expected-test admission.
The dummy SDK/app/loader bytes are fixtures, never installable firmware evidence.
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

TOP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(TOP / 'tools'))
import build as builder
import fm1pkg_make as package


class SmkUpdateContract(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.runner = (TOP / 'tests/run_tests.sh').read_text()
        self.gate = (TOP / 'tools/gate.sh').read_text()
        self.env = os.environ.copy()

    def run_shell(self, source):
        return subprocess.run(['sh', '-c', source], cwd=self.root, env=self.env,
                              text=True, capture_output=True)

    def test_update_consumers_without_fm1_build(self):
        for name in ('firmware', 'tools', 'web'):
            (self.root / name).symlink_to(TOP / name, target_is_directory=True)
        (self.root / 'tests').mkdir()
        for name in ('ota_test.c', 'ldr_test.c', 'smk_pkg_test.py', 'install_test.py'):
            shutil.copy2(TOP / 'tests' / name, self.root / 'tests' / name)
        out = self.root / 'build/smk37'
        (out / 'loader').mkdir(parents=True)
        # Deliberately different old/new app contents after truncating at 200000 bytes.
        (out / 'x0x.bin').write_bytes(bytes(range(256)) * 1000)
        rng = random.Random(37)
        loader = b'FELUCCA-LOADER-1\0' + bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(2048))
        (out / 'loader/ota.bin').write_bytes(builder.ldr_wrap(loader))
        sdk = self.root / 'sdk'
        for name in ('uboot.boot', 'cfg_tool.bin', 'cfg/eq_cfg_hw.bin'):
            path = sdk / 'cpu/wl82/tools' / name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(bytes(range(128)))
        self.env['AC79_SDK'] = str(sdk)
        # The built-package tests require both supported model identities.
        old_sdk, old_board = package.SDK, package.BOARD
        self.addCleanup(package.set_board, old_board)
        self.addCleanup(setattr, package, 'SDK', old_sdk)
        package.SDK = sdk
        package.set_board('smk37')
        flash = package.flash_image((out / 'x0x.bin').read_bytes(), package.KEY)
        ota = (out / 'loader/ota.bin').read_bytes()
        for suffix, model in (('', 'Pro'), ('-elite', 'Elite')):
            (self.root / f'build/x0x-smk37{suffix}.fwsc').write_bytes(
                package.ufw(flash, ota, f'SMK-37 {model}_900'))
        start = self.runner.rindex('\nif ', 0, self.runner.index('    run smk-package')) + 1
        end = self.runner.index('# SMK-37 Bluetooth MIDI:', start)
        prelude = '''set -u
CC="${CC:-cc}"
OUT=build/host
FAIL=0
mkdir -p "$OUT"
run() { name="$1"; shift; if "$@"; then echo "  ok   $name"; else FAIL=1; fi; }
'''
        result = self.run_shell(prelude + self.runner[start:end] +
                                '\nrun installer python3 tests/install_test.py\nexit "$FAIL"\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        for name in ('smk-package', 'smk-ota-entry', 'smk-ota-entry-model1',
                     'smk-ota-entry-model2', 'smk-update-loader', 'smk-build-package',
                     'smk-build-package-elite', 'installer'):
            self.assertIn('  ok   ' + name + '\n', result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('skipped', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('logical_image / product_of == fm1pkg.js (x0x-smk37.fwsc', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('protected ranges untouched', result.stdout)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'build/x0x.fwsc').exists())
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'build/x0x.bin').exists())

    def test_gate_checks_both_models_and_configuration_budgets(self):
        # Stub only the target compiler entry point; execute the actual gate loops.
        logs = self.root / 'logs'
        logs.mkdir()
        self.env.pop('MODEL', None)
        self.env['L'] = str(logs)
        stub = self.root / 'build.sh'
        stub.write_text("#!/bin/sh\n[ \"$*\" = '--board smk37' ] || exit 91\n"
                        "echo \"${MODEL:-pro} $X0X_DEV_PADCAL\" >> calls\n")
        stub.chmod(0o755)
        build_fn = self.gate.split('build_config() {\n', 1)[1].split('\n}\n', 1)[0]
        command = ('build_config() {\n' + build_fn + '\n}\n'
                   'build_config "$PWD" "$HOME" "$PWD" 1 ""\n'
                   'build_config "$PWD" "$HOME" "$PWD" 0 -rel\n')
        result = subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', command], cwd=self.root, env=self.env,
                                text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'calls').read_text().splitlines(),
                         ['elite 1', 'pro 1', 'elite 0', 'pro 0'])
        builds = ('elite', 'pro', 'elite-rel', 'pro-rel')
        self.assertEqual({p.name for p in logs.glob('*.rc')},
                         {f'build-{name}.rc' for name in builds})
        status = self.gate.split('for c in "dev:" "rel:-rel"; do', 1)[1].split('\nPCT=', 1)[0]
        budget = self.gate.split('num() {', 1)[1].split('\n# X0X_RAM_CANARY:', 1)[0]
        checks = ('failed=0\nfail() { echo "$*"; failed=1; }\n'
                  'for c in "dev:" "rel:-rel"; do' + status + '\nnum() {' + budget +
                  '\nexit "$failed"\n')
        valid = 'app code area 1024 B, 10 B free\nRAM .data+.bss 20 B of 30\npool 100 B of 8292\n'
        for name in builds:
            (logs / f'build-{name}.log').write_text(valid)
        def check():
            return subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', checks], cwd=self.root, env=self.env,
                                  text=True, capture_output=True)
        result = check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        for name in builds:
            rc = logs / f'build-{name}.rc'
            rc.write_text('1\n')
            self.assertNotEqual(check().returncode, 0)
            rc.write_text('0\n')
            log = logs / f'build-{name}.log'
            for bad in (valid.replace('10 B free', 'over limit'),
                        valid.replace('20 B of 30', '31 B of 30'),
                        valid.replace('100 B of 8292', '101 B of 8292')):
                log.write_text(bad)
                self.assertNotEqual(check().returncode, 0, name + ': ' + bad)
            log.write_text(valid)

    def test_gate_expected_tests_require_smk_coverage(self):
        (self.root / 'tests').mkdir()
        (self.root / 'tests/run_tests.sh').write_text(self.runner +
            '\nrun quoted-comment echo "# literal" # run phantom not-a-test\n')
        # Execute the real expectation function without any gate setup or build.
        function = self.gate.split('expected_tests() {\n', 1)[1].split('\n}\n', 1)[0]
        log = self.root / 'tests.log'
        log.write_text('')
        expected, missing = self.root / 'expected', self.root / 'missing'
        command = 'expected_tests() {\n' + function + '\n}\nexpected_tests tests.log expected missing\n'
        result = self.run_shell(command)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        names = set(expected.read_text().splitlines())
        required = {'smk-package', 'smk-ota-entry', 'smk-ota-entry-model1',
                    'smk-ota-entry-model2', 'smk-update-loader', 'installer',
                    'smk-build-package', 'smk-build-package-elite', 'ble-package',
                    'smk-update-contract'}
        self.assertTrue(required <= names, required - names)
        self.assertTrue({'ota-entry', 'update-loader', 'storage', 'phantom'}.isdisjoint(names))
        self.assertIn('quoted-comment', names)
        log.write_text(''.join('  ok   ' + name + '\n' for name in sorted(names)))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_shell(command).returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(missing.read_text().strip(), '')
        for removed in sorted(required):
            log.write_text(''.join('  ok   ' + name + '\n' for name in sorted(names - {removed})))
            self.assertEqual(self.run_shell(command).returncode, 0)
            self.assertEqual(missing.read_text().strip(), removed)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Release numbers, codec boundaries, and serialized allocation."""

import json
from multiprocessing import Process, Queue
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
import build  # noqa: E402
from release_alloc import (PRESERVED_UNVERSIONED, ReleaseError, allocate_committed,
                           allocate_file, bind_committed, bind_file, empty_ledger, product_for)


def git(repo, *args):
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "-C", str(repo), "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t", *args],
                          stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)


def git_out(repo, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], text=True).strip()


def make_source(path, text):
    """A real commit and the Git tree id of that commit."""
    path.mkdir()
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main", str(path)], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    (path / "firmware.c").write_text(text)
    git(path, "add", "firmware.c")
    git(path, "commit", "-qm", "source")
    commit = git_out(path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    tree = git_out(path, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}")
    return commit, tree


def stamp(path):
    return (git_out(path, "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
            git_out(path, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"),
            subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(path), "status", "--porcelain"], text=True))


def race_worker(repo, remote, commit, tree, queue):
    try:
        item = allocate_committed(Path(repo), commit, tree, remote=remote)
        queue.put(item["version"])
    except Exception as exc:
        queue.put("ERR " + type(exc).__name__ + " " + str(exc))


class ReleaseAllocationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.ledger = Path(self.tmp.name) / "ledger.json"

    def test_codec_boundaries_and_display_split(self):
        ident = build.release_identity("0.1.3")
        self.assertEqual(ident["numeric"], "0.1.3")
        self.assertEqual(ident["digits"], "000103")
        self.assertEqual(ident["release_label"], "0.1.3_openbeta")
        self.assertEqual(ident["version_macro"], "0.1.3")
        same = build.release_identity("0.1.3-openbeta")
        self.assertEqual(same["numeric"], ident["numeric"])
        self.assertEqual(same["digits"], ident["digits"])
        self.assertIsNone(build.release_identity("0.1.3-rc1")["release_label"])
        self.assertEqual(build.release_identity("99.99.99")["digits"], "999999")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build.release_identity("0.1.3_openbeta")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build.release_identity("100.0.0")
        self.assertEqual(product_for("elite", "0.1.3"), "SMK-37 Elite_9000103")
        self.assertEqual(product_for("pro", "0.1.3"), "SMK-37 Pro_9000103")
        self.assertLessEqual(len(product_for("elite", "99.99.99")), 20)
        self.assertNotIn("openbeta", product_for("elite", "0.1.3"))

    def test_rebuild_preserves_identity_and_rollover_is_explicit(self):
        commit, tree = "a" * 40, "b" * 40
        first = allocate_file(self.ledger, commit, tree)
        second = allocate_file(self.ledger, commit, tree)
        self.assertEqual(first["version"], "0.1.0")
        self.assertEqual(second["version"], first["version"])
        self.assertEqual(len(json.loads(self.ledger.read_text())["allocations"]), 1)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ReleaseError, "different source commit"):
            allocate_file(self.ledger, "f" * 40, tree)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ReleaseError, "40-character"):
            allocate_file(self.ledger, commit, "d" * 64)
        other = allocate_file(self.ledger, "c" * 40, "d" * 40)
        self.assertEqual(other["version"], "0.1.1")
        with self.assertRaises(ReleaseError):
            allocate_file(self.ledger, PRESERVED_UNVERSIONED, "e" * 40)
        for current, nxt in (("0.1.99", "0.2.0"), ("0.99.99", "1.0.0")):
            major, minor, patch = (int(part) for part in current.split("."))
            ledger = empty_ledger()

    def test_file_lock_retries_colliding_allocations(self):
        barrier = threading.Barrier(6)
        found = []
        guard = threading.Lock()

        def work(number):
            barrier.wait()
            item = allocate_file(self.ledger, f"{number:040x}", f"{number:040x}")
            with guard:
                found.append(item["version"])

        threads = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(i,)) for i in range(6)]
        for thread in threads:
            thread.start()
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join()
        self.assertEqual(sorted(found), ["0.1.0", "0.1.1", "0.1.2", "0.1.3", "0.1.4", "0.1.5"])

    def test_git_push_collision_retries_and_rebuild_reuses(self):
        root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        bare = root / "bare.git"
        subprocess.check_call(["git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", str(bare)], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        left, right = root / "left", root / "right"
        left_commit, left_tree = make_source(left, "left\n")
        right_commit, right_tree = make_source(right, "right\n")
        self.assertNotEqual(left_tree, right_tree)
        queue = Queue()
        first = Process(target=race_worker, args=(str(left), str(bare), left_commit, left_tree, queue))
        second = Process(target=race_worker, args=(str(right), str(bare), right_commit, right_tree, queue))
        first.start()
        second.start()
        first.join(30)
        second.join(30)
        self.assertFalse(first.is_alive() or second.is_alive())
        results = sorted(queue.get() for _ in range(2))
        self.assertEqual(results, ["0.1.0", "0.1.1"], results)
        reused = allocate_committed(left, left_commit, left_tree, remote=str(bare))
        self.assertEqual(reused["source_commit"], left_commit)
        self.assertEqual(reused["source_tree"], left_tree)
        self.assertIn(reused["version"], results)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run actual boot preparation/setter/state on native stubs; never access hardware.

Use --source-root for a broken-base negative control. Image validation itself is
covered by ble_test; RF initialization and interrupt timing need target evidence.
"""
import argparse
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--source-root', type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])
args = p.parse_args()
root = args.source_root.resolve()
source = (root / 'firmware/src/ble.c').read_text()
parts = []
for signature in ('static void ble_prepare(int on)', 'int plat_ble_state(void)', 'void plat_ble_set(int on)'):
    start = source.index(signature + '\n{')
    end = source.index('\n}\n', start) + 3
    parts.append(source[start:end])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ble-toggle-') as directory:
    scratch = Path(directory)
    (scratch / 'ble_toggle.inc').write_text('\n'.join(parts))
    exe = scratch / 'test'
    subprocess.run([os.environ.get('CC', 'cc'), '-std=c99', '-O1', '-g', '-Wall',
                    '-Wextra', '-Werror', '-Wno-unused-function',
                    '-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-sanitize-recover=all',
                    '-I' + str(scratch), '-I' + str(root / 'firmware/hal'),
                    '-I' + str(root / 'firmware/src/ble'),
                    '-I' + str(root / 'firmware/src/app'),
                    str(Path(__file__).with_suffix('.c')), '-o', str(exe)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True)
